pāka.cp: adj. cooking; that which is cooked; ripening.
pāka.p: [ paca + ṇa. Pāko pacanaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 1050. (vi+paca+ṇa. Vipāka huchiuliulyaka vi-kyesañña. Tanaññaḥ- vipāka၏ pariyāya. Jū, 1. 281. ] (pu) Google Translate (1) Cook-cook-boil-fry-roast-bake-roast. (2) Ripening. (3) Benefits. (4) Asura. Brother of Vatra Asura. (5) Monk. (Ti) (6) What is given. (7) First-to-roast-to. (8) Ripeness. (9) Grazing place. (10) cooking place; Fire place. (11) Benefits. (12) Beneficial-vipaka-mind. (13) Ripe.

H: pāka：m．[cf．pacati] 被煮之物，調理的食物．-haṃsa 鵞鳥．
S: pāka：m．[cf．pacati] 煮られた物，調理した食物．-haṃsa 鵞鳥．
D: Pāka，【阳】 烹饪，被烹调的（饭、菜），成熟。 ~vaṭṭa，【中】 食物的连续补给。（p221）
F: Pāka，【阳】烹饪，被烹调的（饭、菜），成熟。pākavaṭṭa，【中】食物的连续补给。
C: pāka：[adj．] cooking； that which is cooked； ripening．
P:
Pāka，[Vedic pāka，see pacati] that which is cooked，cooking，quantity cooked J．VI，161 （tīhi pākehi pacitvā）； VvA．186．Esp．in foll．combn tela° “oil cooking，” an oil decoction Vin．II，105； thāli° a th．full of cooking J．I，186； doṇa° a d．full S．I，81； DhA．II，8； sosāna° Dhātumañjūsā 132 （under kaṭh）．On pāka in appld meaning of “effect，result” see Cpd．883．-- As nt．in stanza “pākaṁ pākassa paccayo； apākaṁ avipākassa” at VbhA．175．-- Cp．vi°．

--tela an oil concoction or mixture，used for rubbing the body； usually given with its price worth 100 or 1，000 pieces，e．g．sata° J．II，397； V，376； VvA．68= DhA．III，311； sahassa° J．III，372．--vaṭṭa subsistence，livelihood，maintenance Mhvs 35，120； DhA．II，29； VvA．220．--haṁsa a species of water bird J．V，356； VI，539； SnA 277．（Page 449）
U: PĀKA：[m] sự nấu，vật đã nấu chín，sự làm cho chín --vaṭṭa [nt] tiếp tục cung cấp vật thực
R:
pāka：ပါက （ပ） （√ပစ်+ဏ）
ချက်ခြင်း။ အကျိုးဖြစ်ခြင်း။ ကျက်ခြင်း။ ဖုတ်ခြင်း။
ပါကာယ၊ ချက်ခြင်းအလို့ငှာ။
DOP: paka m.f. [pa 3 + ka 2 ], drinking; — ifc see khīra-, dhenu-.

pāka m.n. ( and mfn. ?) [ ts ], 1. ( m.n. ) ( i ) cooking; being cooked; cooked food; baking; firing; Abh 762 (pacā ~e); 1050; Ja VI 161, 27 (tīhi ~ehi pacitvā khādituṃ [vaṭṭati]); Vism 504, 21 (mandagginā antobhājane ~o viya soko); Sp 704, 17 foll. (ayopatto pañcahi ~ehi mattikāpatto dvīhi ~ehi pakko adhiṭṭhānūpago); Spk III 25, 6 (imaṃ [kukkuṭam] tīhi ~ehi pacitvā amhākaṃ upaṭṭhapehī ti); Nidd-a I 401, 19 (muggasūpe paccante bahū muggā ~aṃ gacchanti thokā na gacchanti); Sadd 845, 14 (pacanaṃ ~o); — ifc see odana-, tela-, thālī-, doṇa-, puṭa-, puna-; — ( ii ) a place for cooking or firing; Spk II 81, 3 (~ato kumbhakārabhājanānaṃ nīharaṇadaṇḍako); — ifc see kumbhakāra- ( sv kumbha 2 ); — ( iii ) inflammation; — ifc see akkhi- ( sv akkhi 1 ); — 2. ( m. ) ripeness, ripening; ageing; Ap 386, 2 (dhaññaṃ me phalinaṃ ahu, °-kāle ca sampatte); As 341, 5 (na ca ~o paccati bhedo vā bhijjatī ti); — 3. ( m.n. ) result; consequence; Abh 1050 (~o vipāke); Vism 563, 27* (~aṃ ~assa paccayo); 603, 7* (kammaṃ natthi vipākamhi ~o kamme na vijjati); Mp II 9, 2 (~ato pi viññātabbo vinicchayo); As 42, 10 (aññamaññaṃ visiṭṭhānaṃ kusalākusalānaṃ ~ā ti vipākā); — 4. ( mfn. ) [= pakka?], fired, heated; Ja VI 268, 18* (jambonadassa ~assa suvaṇṇassa uracchado; 268, 21´ : jambonadassa pakkassa rattasuvaṇṇassa, Be so; Ce only rattasuvaṇṇassa; Ee jambonadapākapakkhassa; Se jamborasato jātassa pākassa); — pākaṃ in Ee, Se at Sp 1102, 28 is prob. wr for pānaṃ ( Be, Ce so ); — pākaṃ in Ce, Ee at It-a II 12, 26 is prob. wr; Be, Se bādhakaṃ; — pāko in eds at Peṭ 156, 24 : read paṅko with Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 215; — °- ṭṭhāna , n. , a kitchen; Abh 211; — °- vaṭṭa , °- vatta , n. , a regular supply of cooked food; Sp 357, 30 (yaṃ pi ~’-atthāya vihāre ṭhapenti); Dhp-a II 29, 18 (tassa taṃ gehe ~aṃ jātaṃ itarassa gehe na paccati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-bhattaṃ); III 291, 9 (kapaṇaddhikānaṃ pi gehadvāre ~aṃ paṭṭhapesi) = Vv-a 220, 26 ; Mhv 35:120; — apākavaṭṭā in Ee at Bv-a 54, 20 is wr for apākaṭattā ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- haṃsa , m. , a kind of goose; Ja V 357, 5 ; VI 539, 14* ; Pj II 277, 12 ( in cpd ); — apāka , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) not cooked; Ja I 340, 2 (paccamānaṃ odanaṃ ~aṃ addasaṃ); — 2. ( n. ) not a result; absence of ripening; Vism 563, 28* (~aṃ avipākassa chadhā chaṭṭhassa paccayo) = Vibh-a 175, 9* .
